bug_report_content:
Title: More robust charset detection code
State: closed

Description:
With the following HTML:

```
<html lang="en-US">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; " />
</head>
```

jsoup fails to parse the page with a IllegalCharsetNameException. I see that http-equiv="Content-Type" has an invalid content-type but it would be possible to still parse it correctly by using the html5  <meta charset="UTF-8">, i.e. jsoup could be more robust on this one.

other domains which are not working but could be:
9kuhkep.net
www.a-bright.org

I use this code to parse the sites:

```
Jsoup.connect(url).execute()
```
